verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a cloud accounting/ledger SaaS like Digits, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions choosing a storage region or residency. The security material covers only encryption at rest, envelope encryption, TLS and SOC 2, which are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
